# A2H Agency

> AI Receptionist + CRM for Texas local service businesses, with hand-coded custom websites available as an upgrade. Answers every call and text, books directly onto the calendar, and logs every contact automatically.

A2H builds an AI phone receptionist and CRM for businesses that lose revenue to missed calls: contractors, medical and dental practices, local retail, and mobile pet groomers/pet cleaning businesses. Flat, published pricing with no long-term contract.

## Pricing
- AI Receptionist + CRM: $1,500 one-time setup, then $397/month. Answers every call, books appointments, logs every contact in a CRM pipeline. Cancel anytime.
- AI Receptionist + CRM + Custom Website: $2,000 one-time setup, then $400/month. Adds a hand-coded website (up to 10 pages) and Google Business Profile setup.
- Extra CRM seat: $99/month per seat.
- AI Website Chatbot add-on: $99/month (Custom Website tier only).
- Care Plan (hosting, maintenance, monthly content edits): $249/month, included with Custom Website tier, cancel anytime.
